slides.teacher_cue: New suffix pattern — -tion. Four letters, two sounds: /ʃ/ + /ən/. The t does not say /t/ here — it says /ʃ/ when followed by ion. This is one of the most common suffixes in English academic vocabulary: action, nation, station, motion, section, fiction, fraction, mention, option, question. Rule: -tion at the end of a word = /ʃən/.
slides.expected_response: Students recognise -tion as a unit making /ʃən/ and read multi-syllable -tion words correctly.
slides.correction_move: Establish -tion as a chunk: say /ʃən/ as a unit, then add the root before it. act + tion = action. na + tion = nation. Students blend the root + the chunk.
slides.observation_note: Watch for students trying to decode t-i-o-n individually. Redirect — -tion is a chunk that says /ʃən/.

slides.teacher_cue: Say action — the process of doing something. act + tion. Confirm /ʃən/ at end. Reveal and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say action orally and connect meaning before blending.
slides.correction_move: Model action orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for the /ʃən/ chunk — not /tɪɒn/.

slides.teacher_cue: Say nation — a country. na + tion. The a in na is long /eɪ/ because of the open syllable. Reveal and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say nation orally and connect meaning before blending.
slides.correction_move: Model nation orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for long /eɪ/ in the open syllable and /ʃən/ chunk.

slides.teacher_cue: Say station — a place where trains stop. sta + tion. Reveal and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say station orally and connect meaning before blending.
slides.correction_move: Model station orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for /ʃən/ chunk and long /eɪ/ in open syllable sta.

slides.teacher_cue: Say motion — movement. mo + tion. Long /oʊ/ in open syllable. Reveal and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say motion orally and connect meaning before blending.
slides.correction_move: Model motion orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for /ʃən/ chunk and long /oʊ/ in open syllable mo.

slides.teacher_cue: Say section — a part of something. sect + ion. Short vowel in closed syllable. Reveal and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say section orally and connect meaning before blending.
slides.correction_move: Model section orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for short /e/ in sect and /ʃən/ chunk.

slides.teacher_cue: Say fiction — invented stories. fict + ion. Confirm /f/ onset. Reveal and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say fiction orally and connect meaning before blending.
slides.correction_move: Model fiction orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for /p/ on /f/ and /ʃən/ chunk.
